keywords: EIP-8250 与 EIP-8272 提议进入 Hegotá
summary: Vitalik 在 ethresear.ch 发表 The Extremely Lean Chain，设想把共识链状态责任推给质押者，由他们管理并偶尔 ZK 证明自己的状态，同时加入强验证者隐私。nero_eth 发表 Native UTXOs on Ethereum，借鉴比特币一次性支付对象来避免收款永久增加状态。soispoke 宣布 keyed nonce（EIP-8250）和 recent roots（EIP-8272）正式提议进入 Hegotá。EIP-8141 允许任意签名数据的修改合并。当晚召开 ACDT #86。

items.title: ethresear.ch：Native UTXOs on Ethereum
items.note: 13:52（Nero_eth）。在以太坊上，地址首次收到 ETH 会产生永久账户叶子，首次持有 ERC-20 会产生永久存储槽；比特币的支付是一次性对象，创建一次、花费一次，然后从状态删除。文章探讨把这一性质引入以太坊。
items.note_en: 13:52 (Nero_eth). On Ethereum, the first ETH an address receives creates a permanent account leaf, and the first ERC-20 it holds a permanent storage slot; a Bitcoin payment is a one-shot object, created once, spent once and then deleted from state. The post explores borrowing that property.

items.title: EIP-8141：允许任意签名数据，避免自定义验证器的循环依赖
items.note: （lightclient）合并，自定义验证器由此可以使用规范签名哈希。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: allow arbitrary signature data to avoid a circular dependency for custom verifiers
items.note_en: (lightclient), merged, so custom verifiers can use the canonical signing hash.

items.note: 14:30：用 ZK 断开存款、质押活动与提款的关联，并每天重新匿名化质押者。
items.title_en: Vitalik: a path to make the Lean consensus chain aggressively leaner and add strong validator privacy
items.note_en: 14:30: ZK-unlinking deposits from staking activity from withdrawals, and re-anonymizing stakers every day.
items.topic_en: Consensus: an extremely lean chain and validator privacy

items.topic: 共识层：极简链与验证者隐私
items.title: ethresear.ch：The Extremely Lean Chain
items.note: 14:00（vbuterin）。在单 slot 最终性、基于递归 STARK 的抗量子签名聚合等 Lean 升级背景下，把责任推给质押者管理并偶尔 ZK 证明其状态，从而去掉 epoch 末处理（少 slot 最终性下可能每 16 秒一次），共识或可扩展到数百万验证者。
items.note_en: 14:00 (vbuterin). With Lean upgrades such as single-slot finality and recursive-STARK-based quantum-resistant signature aggregation, stakers take responsibility for managing and occasionally ZK-proving their state, removing end-of-epoch processing (which in few-slot finality may run every 16 seconds) and possibly letting consensus scale to millions of validators.

keywords_en: EIP-8250 and EIP-8272 proposed for Hegotá
summary_en: Vitalik published The Extremely Lean Chain on ethresear.ch, pushing consensus state responsibility to stakers, who manage and occasionally ZK-prove their own state, while adding strong validator privacy. nero_eth published Native UTXOs on Ethereum, borrowing Bitcoin's one-shot payment objects so that receiving a payment need not add state forever. soispoke announced that keyed nonces (EIP-8250) and recent roots (EIP-8272) are officially proposed for Hegotá. An EIP-8141 change allowing arbitrary signature data was merged. ACDT #86 was held in the evening.
